fusions.name: Line Played Out
fusions.desc: A barbed cast that deals 18 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.8 times at maximum range. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Barb
fusions.desc: A barbed strike that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 10% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep-Calling Song
fusions.desc: A song that pulls up to 5 enemies within 9 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbs Set Deep
fusions.desc: Every hit you land sets a barb in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it tears them all out, striking it for 34% of your weapon damage per barb (170% at full). Unfed, a barb falls out every 4 seconds.
